recipes.name: Rabo de Toro
recipes.description: Cordoba's oxtail stew braised in red wine until gelatinous and profound.

steps.instruction: Flour and brown oxtail well; set aside.
Soften vegetables; add paprika, puree, wine.
Return tails with water to cover; braise 3-3.5 hours until collapsing.
Reduce sauce to a rich glaze; season.

videos.videoTitle: DELICIOUSLY TENDER - SPANISH OXTAIL IN RED WINE - RABO DE TORO (the classic recipe)

recipes.name: Carne con Tomate
recipes.description: Everyday Catalan stew of pork-free beef cubes simmered in tomato with a splash of brandy.

steps.instruction: Brown beef; flambé with brandy.
Add onion, garlic, tomatoes, bay; simmer covered 60 minutes.
Uncover to thicken; season; serve with rice or potatoes.

videos.videoTitle: Magro de cerdo con tomate, un verdadero clásico 👌 #recetas #receta

recipes.name: Albóndigas en Salsa
recipes.description: Soft meatballs in saffron-tomato sauce - tapas-bar soul food.

steps.instruction: Mix meat with soaked breadcrumbs, garlic, parsley; roll balls; flour lightly.
Fry until browned all over; remove.
Simmer sauce with wine + saffron; return balls 20 minutes.

videos.videoTitle: Albóndigas en salsa ¡irresistibles! (receta casera y fácil)

recipes.name: Cocido Madrileño (Beef-Forward)
recipes.description: Madrid's three-course chickpea monument led by beef shank, morcilla-free for this version.

steps.instruction: Simmer beef with aromatics 90 minutes, skimming.
Add chickpeas and beef sausage; cook 60 more.
Add vegetables last 45 minutes.
Serve broth-with-noodles first; then platter with pimentón oil.

videos.videoTitle: Cocido Madrileño BRUTAL con solo con dos Trucos ¡Caldo y carnes PERFECTOS !

recipes.name: Pollo al Ajillo
recipes.description: Garlic chicken: crisp pieces bathed in olive oil, sliced garlic and bay - tapa royalty.

steps.instruction: Salt chicken 30 minutes ahead.
Fry in oil with garlic over medium-low until gold and cooked through.
Splash wine; reduce 2 minutes; serve with bread for the oil.

videos.videoTitle: Pollo al Ajillo | Recetas de Cocina Española

recipes.name: Arroz con Pollo
recipes.description: Saffron-yellow one-pan rice with chicken, sofrito and peas.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken; add sofrito and pimentón.
Stir in rice; pour hot saffron stock around.
Simmer undisturbed 18 minutes; rest 5; scatter peas and peppers.

videos.videoTitle: The FAMOUS Spanish Chicken and Rice | Authentic Arroz con Pollo Recipe

recipes.name: Pinchos Morunos de Pollo
recipes.description: Moorish-spiced chicken skewers sizzling from the plancha.

ingredients.name: Pincho Marinade
ingredients.note: paprika, cumin, oregano, garlic, lemon, oil

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken 2+ hours.
Thread snugly onto skewers.
Grill/plancha hot 10 minutes, turning once.

recipes.name: Pollo al Chilindrón
recipes.description: Aragonese chicken stewed with jam-style red peppers and cured-ham-free tomato base here.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken; soften peppers and onion long and slow.
Add garlic, tomato, wine; return chicken.
Cover and stew 35 minutes until silky.

recipes.name: Tortilla Española
recipes.description: Potato-onion omelette, custardy inside, gold outside - Spain's national treasure.

steps.instruction: Confit potato and onion in warm oil ~25 min until meltingly soft; drain well.
Fold into beaten salted eggs; rest 10 minutes.
Cook in a little oil; flip via plate at half-set; finish just-wet inside.

videos.videoTitle: La Autentica Tortilla de Patatas Española

recipes.name: Pisto Manchego
recipes.description: La Mancha's ratatouille of zucchini, pepper and tomato, crowned with a fried egg.

steps.instruction: Soften onion and peppers in oil 15 minutes.
Add zucchini then tomato; stew low 25 minutes.
Season; serve crowned with fried eggs.

recipes.name: Gazpacho Andaluz
recipes.description: Ice-cold blended tomato-bread soup with cucumber, pepper and sherry vinegar.

steps.instruction: Blend everything until velvety; adjust vinegar/salt cold.
Chill minimum 2 hours.
Serve with diced toppings and an oil swirl.

videos.videoTitle: Gazpacho andaluz 🍅 Receta tradicional, fácil y refrescante

recipes.name: Patatas Bravas
recipes.description: Crisp potato cubes under fiery bravas sauce and optional garlic aioli.

steps.instruction: Parboil potatoes 8 minutes; drain and steam-dry.
Roast/fry at high heat until crusty.
Simmer sauce ingredients 10 minutes; spoon over; zigzag aioli.

recipes.name: Crema Catalana
recipes.description: Citrus-cinnamon custard branded with a hot iron - older than crème brûlée and prouder.

steps.instruction: Infuse milk with peel and cinnamon; whisk into yolks, sugar, starch.
Cook stirring until thickened; pot and chill 4 hours.
Sugar-coat; burn with iron until glassed.

recipes.name: Churros con Chocolate
recipes.description: Ridged fried dough sticks for dunking into thick drinking chocolate.

steps.instruction: Make a scalded choux-like dough; rest 15 minutes.
Pipe 15cm strips into 190°C oil; cut with scissors; fry golden.
Melt chocolate into milk with slurry until thick.
Dust churros with sugar; dunk relentlessly.

recipes.name: Solomillo al Whisky
recipes.description: Pork loin seared and flambéed with whisky, garlic, and a creamy sauce

steps.instruction: Season pork medallions with salt and pepper
Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear the pork on both sides until golden
Remove pork and sauté garlic until fragrant
Add whisky and carefully flambé
Stir in heavy cream and simmer until sauce thickens
Return pork to the pan and coat with the sauce

recipes.name: Ternera a la Jardinera
recipes.description: Tender beef braised with seasonal garden vegetables in a light broth

steps.instruction: Brown beef cubes in olive oil over high heat
Add onion and cook until softened
Add tomato, potatoes, and carrots, stir
Pour in beef broth and add bay leaf
Cover and simmer for 45 minutes until beef is tender
Add green beans and peas, cook 10 more minutes
Season with salt and serve

recipes.name: Tostas de Carne
recipes.description: Crispy toast topped with seasoned shredded beef, roasted peppers, and alioli

steps.instruction: Toast bread slices until golden and crispy
Sauté beef with garlic and smoked paprika in olive oil
Season with salt
Spread alioli on each toast
Top with sautéed beef and roasted pepper slices

recipes.name: Olla Podrida
recipes.description: Traditional Castilian mixed meat and vegetable stew slow-cooked in a clay pot

steps.instruction: Heat olive oil and brown beef, pork, and chorizo
Add onion, garlic, and bay leaves
Add chickpeas, potatoes, carrots, and cabbage
Pour in water to cover everything
Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours
Season with salt and serve the broth with the meats and vegetables

recipes.name: Caldereta de Cordero
recipes.description: Rich lamb stew from La Mancha with tomato, peppers, and herbs

steps.instruction: Season lamb with salt and pepper
Brown lamb in olive oil over high heat
Add onion, garlic, and green pepper, cook until soft
Add tomato and cook down for 5 minutes
Deglaze with white wine and reduce slightly
Add broth, bay leaf, and thyme
Simmer covered for 1.5 hours until lamb is very tender

recipes.name: Carpaccio de Ternera
recipes.description: Paper-thin raw beef slices drizzled with olive oil, capers, and Parmesan

steps.instruction: Arrange beef slices on a chilled plate in a single layer
Top with arugula leaves
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with Parmesan shavings and capers

recipes.name: Entrecot a la Pimienta
recipes.description: Juicy beef entrecote seared in a cracked pepper crust with brandy sauce

steps.instruction: Press cracked peppercorns firmly onto both sides of the steak
Heat butter in a cast-iron skillet over high heat
Sear entrecote 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare
Remove steak and rest
Sauté shallot in the same pan, deglaze with brandy
Add cream and simmer until sauce coats a spoon
Slice steak and pour sauce over

recipes.name: Chuletillas de Cordero al Horno
recipes.description: Herb-crusted lamb chops roasted in the oven with rosemary and garlic

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 220C
Mix olive oil, rosemary, garlic, lemon zest, salt, and pepper
Coat lamb chops with the herb mixture
Sear chops in a hot ovenproof skillet for 2 minutes per side
Transfer skillet to oven and roast for 8-10 minutes
Rest 5 minutes before serving

recipes.name: Filetes Empanados
recipes.description: Thin beef fillets breaded and pan-fried until golden and crispy

steps.instruction: Pound beef fillets to an even thinness
Season with salt and pepper
Dredge in flour, dip in beaten egg, then coat in breadcrumbs
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
Fry each filete 2-3 minutes per side until golden
Drain on paper towels and serve with lemon

recipes.name: Lomo en Salsa
recipes.description: Pork loin simmered in a rich tomato and roasted pepper sauce

steps.instruction: Season pork with salt and pepper
Brown pork medallions in olive oil
Remove pork and sauté onion and garlic
Add grated tomato and roasted pepper, cook 5 minutes
Deglaze with white wine
Return pork, add bay leaf, cover and simmer 30 minutes

recipes.name: Morcilla de Burgos
recipes.description: Traditional blood sausage from Burgos packed with rice, onion, and spices

steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat
Place morcilla slices in the pan
Cook 2-3 minutes per side until the casing is crispy
Drain briefly on paper towels
Serve hot on slices of crusty bread

recipes.name: Chorizo a la Sidra
recipes.description: Spicy chorizo sausages simmered in Spanish cider with bay and garlic

steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat
Add chorizo slices and sear until browned
Add garlic and bay leaf, stir briefly
Pour in cider and bring to a simmer
Cook uncovered for 10 minutes until sauce reduces
Serve hot directly from the pan

recipes.name: Chistorra con Huevos
recipes.description: Thin chistorra sausage pan-fried with eggs and a touch of paprika

steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat
Add chistorra and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes
Sprinkle with smoked paprika
Crack eggs directly over the chistorra
Cook until eggs are set to your liking
Season with salt and serve with bread

recipes.name: Albondigas de Carne
recipes.description: Spanish-style meatballs in a savory tomato and almond sauce

steps.instruction: Mix ground beef, pork, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic, parsley, and salt
Roll into walnut-sized meatballs
Brown meatballs in olive oil on all sides
Add tomato sauce, ground almonds, and cinnamon
Simmer covered for 20 minutes until cooked through
Serve with sauce spooned over

recipes.name: Pollo en Pepitoria
recipes.description: Chicken braised in a saffron almond sauce with hard-boiled egg

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and flour
Brown chicken in olive oil and set aside
Sauté onion and garlic until golden
Add toasted almonds and cook briefly
Deglaze with white wine and add broth and saffron
Return chicken with bay leaf, simmer covered for 40 minutes
Stir in chopped hard-boiled egg before serving

recipes.name: Pollo al Chilindron
recipes.description: Chicken stewed with red peppers, tomato, and serrano ham in Aragonese style

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt and pepper
Brown chicken in olive oil and set aside
Sauté ham in the same pan until crispy
Add onion, garlic, and red pepper, cook until soft
Add tomato and cook for 5 minutes
Deglaze with white wine, return chicken
Cover and simmer 35 minutes until tender

recipes.name: Pollo a la Riojana
recipes.description: Chicken braised with chorizo, peppers, and tomato in Riojan style

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt and paprika
Brown chicken in olive oil and set aside
Sauté chorizo until it releases its oil
Add onion, garlic, and pepper, cook until soft
Add tomato and cook for 5 minutes
Pour in wine and broth, return chicken and bay leaf
Simmer covered for 40 minutes

recipes.name: Pollo con Gambas
recipes.description: Tender chicken pieces cooked with garlic prawns in white wine

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt
Sear chicken in olive oil until golden, set aside
Sauté garlic and chili flakes until fragrant
Add prawns and cook 1 minute per side
Add cherry tomatoes and white wine
Return chicken, simmer 5 minutes
Finish with lemon juice and parsley

recipes.name: Pollo al Horno
recipes.description: Classic oven-roasted chicken with potatoes, garlic, and lemon

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 200C
Season chicken with salt and pepper
Arrange potatoes, garlic, and lemon in a roasting pan
Place chicken on top, drizzle everything with olive oil
Add rosemary sprig
Roast for 45-50 minutes until skin is golden and juices run clear

recipes.name: Pollo en Salsa
recipes.description: Chicken simmered in a smooth garlic and white wine sauce

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and flour
Brown chicken in olive oil and set aside
Sauté onion and garlic until golden
Deglaze with white wine and reduce
Add broth and bay leaf
Return chicken, cover and simmer 35 minutes
Garnish with chopped parsley

recipes.name: Croquetas de Pollo
recipes.description: Creamy chicken croquettes breaded and fried until golden

steps.instruction: Melt butter in a saucepan, add flour and stir for 1 minute
Gradually whisk in milk until smooth béchamel forms
Cook until thick, season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg
Fold in shredded chicken, spread on a plate to cool
Refrigerate until firm, then shape into cylinders
Bread in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs
Deep fry at 180C until golden, about 2-3 minutes

recipes.name: Empanada de Pollo
recipes.description: Traditional Galician pastry filled with chicken, sofrito, and peppers

steps.instruction: Sauté onion, garlic, and pepper in olive oil until soft
Add tomato and paprika, cook 5 minutes
Mix in shredded chicken and olives, season with salt
Let filling cool completely
Roll out pastry and spread filling over half, leaving a border
Fold over and seal edges with a fork
Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden

recipes.name: Arroz al Horno
recipes.description: Valencian oven-baked rice with chickpeas, blood sausage, and tomato

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 220C
Heat olive oil in a cazuela or ovenproof dish
Sauté garlic and potato slices until lightly golden
Add paprika and tomato, cook briefly
Add rice and stir to coat
Pour in hot broth with saffron, season with salt
Arrange chickpea and morcilla on top
Bake for 20 minutes until rice absorbs the liquid

recipes.name: Pollo en Escabeche
recipes.description: Chicken poached in a vinegar and aromatic herb pickling broth

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt
Brown chicken in olive oil on all sides
Add carrot, onion, garlic, bay leaves, and peppercorns
Pour in vinegar and water
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer
Cook covered for 30 minutes until chicken is cooked through
Let cool in the broth and serve at room temperature

recipes.name: Pollo con Aceitunas
recipes.description: Chicken braised with green olives, capers, and white wine

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt and pepper
Brown chicken in olive oil and set aside
Sauté onion and garlic until soft
Add tomato and cook for 3 minutes
Deglaze with white wine
Return chicken, add broth, olives, capers, and bay leaf
Simmer covered for 35 minutes

recipes.name: Pollo a la Extremeña
recipes.description: Chicken from Extremadura with tomato, peppers, and a touch of paprika

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and paprika
Brown chicken in olive oil
Add onion, garlic, and pepper, cook until soft
Add tomato and cook for 5 minutes
Deglaze with white wine
Add bay leaf, cover and simmer 35 minutes

recipes.name: Fideuà de Pollo
recipes.description: Short noodles baked with chicken, seafood broth, and alioli

steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat
Sauté chicken until golden, set aside
Sauté garlic and pepper, add tomato and paprika
Add noodles and toast for 2 minutes, stirring
Pour in hot broth with saffron, season with salt
Nestle chicken back in, cook until broth is absorbed
Let rest 5 minutes and serve with alioli

recipes.name: Pollo con Tomate
recipes.description: Simple chicken breast simmered in a fresh tomato and herb sauce

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt and pepper
Sear chicken in olive oil, set aside
Sauté onion and garlic until translucent
Add grated tomato and oregano, cook 8 minutes
Return chicken, cover and simmer 20 minutes
Garnish with parsley and serve

recipes.name: Fricassee de Pollo
recipes.description: Creamy chicken fricassee with mushrooms and white wine

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and flour
Brown chicken in butter, set aside
Sauté onion and garlic until soft
Add mushrooms and cook until browned
Deglaze with white wine and add broth
Return chicken, add thyme, cover and simmer 30 minutes
Stir in cream and heat through

recipes.name: Pollo en Pepitoria con Caldo
recipes.description: Chicken simmered in a light broth with saffron, garlic, and sliced almonds

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and flour
Brown chicken in olive oil and set aside
Sauté onion and garlic until golden
Add broth and saffron, bring to a simmer
Return chicken with bay leaf, cover and cook 35 minutes
Stir in toasted almonds and serve

recipes.name: Salmorejo Cordobes
recipes.description: Thick chilled tomato and bread soup from Córdoba topped with ham and egg

steps.instruction: Blend tomatoes, bread, garlic, and salt until smooth
With the blender running, slowly drizzle in olive oil
Add sherry vinegar and blend again
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour
Serve cold in bowls topped with chopped egg and ham

recipes.name: Pimientos de Padrón
recipes.description: Small green peppers blistered in olive oil and finished with sea salt

steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in a skillet over high heat
Add peppers in a single layer
Blister and turn until charred on all sides, about 3-4 minutes
Transfer to a plate
Sprinkle with flaky sea salt and serve immediately

recipes.name: Judiones de La Granja
recipes.description: Large white beans from Segovia slow-cooked with vegetables and chorizo

steps.instruction: Drain soaked beans and place in a pot with fresh water
Bring to a boil, then simmer for 1 hour until tender
Heat olive oil and sauté onion, carrot, and garlic
Add chorizo and cook briefly
Combine with beans, add bay leaf
Simmer together for 30 minutes
Season with salt and serve

recipes.name: Menestra de Verduras
recipes.description: Spring vegetables gently sautéed and finished with ham and a fried egg

steps.instruction: Blanch carrots and artichokes in salted water for 3 minutes
Heat olive oil in a wide pan
Sauté onion and garlic until soft
Add blanched vegetables and peas
Cook gently for 8-10 minutes until tender
Season with salt, pepper, and parsley

recipes.name: Ensalada Mixta
recipes.description: Classic Spanish mixed salad with tomato, onion, olives, and tuna

steps.instruction: Arrange lettuce on a large plate
Top with tomato slices and onion rings
Add tuna in the center
Garnish with olives and egg quarters
Drizzle with olive oil and sherry vinegar
Season with salt and serve

recipes.name: Pa amb Tomaquet
recipes.description: Catalan bread rubbed with ripe tomato, garlic, and drizzled with olive oil

steps.instruction: Toast bread slices until golden
Rub garlic clove over the warm bread
Rub the cut side of the tomato firmly over the bread
Drizzle generously with olive oil
Sprinkle with flaky salt and serve immediately

recipes.name: Espinacas con Garbanzos
recipes.description: Spinach and chickpeas in a cumin-spiced tomato broth, Seville style

steps.instruction: Heat olive oil and sauté garlic until golden
Add paprika, cumin, and chili flakes, stir briefly
Add grated tomato and cook for 5 minutes
Add chickpeas and a splash of water, simmer 10 minutes
Stir in spinach until wilted
Finish with sherry vinegar and salt

recipes.name: Patatas a lo Pobre
recipes.description: Thinly sliced potatoes fried with peppers, onion, and olive oil

steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in a wide skillet over medium-low heat
Add potato slices in a single layer if possible
Cook gently, turning occasionally, for 15 minutes
Add peppers, onion, and garlic
Continue cooking until everything is very tender, about 10 minutes
Season with salt and serve warm

recipes.name: Berenjenas con Miel de Caña
recipes.description: Crispy fried eggplant drizzled with cane honey and sprinkled with cinnamon

steps.instruction: Salt eggplant slices and let drain for 20 minutes
Pat dry and dust lightly with flour
Heat oil and fry eggplant until golden and crispy
Drain on paper towels
Arrange on a plate and drizzle with cane honey
Sprinkle with cinnamon and serve

recipes.name: Calabacín a la Plancha
recipes.description: Grilled zucchini slices with olive oil, garlic, and fresh herbs

steps.instruction: Heat a griddle pan over high heat
Brush zucchini slices with olive oil on both sides
Grill 3-4 minutes per side until charred lines appear
Transfer to a plate
Drizzle with remaining olive oil and sprinkle with garlic, parsley, and lemon zest
Season with salt and pepper

recipes.name: Tombet
recipes.description: Layered Majorcan vegetables baked with tomato sauce and olive oil

steps.instruction: Lightly fry eggplant and potato slices in olive oil
Roast peppers until skin blisters, peel and slice
Sauté garlic with paprika, add grated tomato and cook into a sauce
Layer vegetables in a baking dish alternating with tomato sauce
Drizzle with olive oil
Bake at 180C for 30 minutes until vegetables are very tender

recipes.name: Escalivada
recipes.description: Smoky roasted eggplant, peppers, and onions drizzled with olive oil

steps.instruction: Place whole eggplant, peppers, and onion under a hot broiler
Roast, turning occasionally, until skin is blackened all over, about 20 minutes
Place in a bowl and cover to steam for 10 minutes
Peel and seed the vegetables, tear into strips
Arrange on a plate, season with salt
Drizzle with olive oil and sherry vinegar, garnish with garlic and parsley

recipes.name: Empadão de Verduras
recipes.description: Savory vegetable pie with a golden crust filled with carrots, peas, and olives

ingredients.name: puff pastry
ingredients.note: rolled out to fit a 20cm pie dish

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until soft
Add carrots and potatoes, cook 5 minutes
Add tomato and peas, season with salt and pepper
Cook until vegetables are just tender, let cool
Line a pie dish with half the pastry
Fill with vegetable mixture, arrange egg slices and olives on top
Cover with remaining pastry, seal edges, brush with beaten egg
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden

recipes.name: Fabada Asturiana
recipes.description: Hearty Asturian bean stew with chorizo and morcilla in a rich saffron broth

steps.instruction: Drain soaked beans and place in a large pot with fresh water
Bring to a boil, skim any foam, then reduce to a gentle simmer
Add whole onion, garlic cloves, and bay leaf
Simmer for 1 hour until beans are nearly tender
Add chorizo, morcilla, and saffron
Cook for another 30 minutes until everything is very soft
Remove onion, season with salt, and serve

recipes.name: Pa amb Tomaquet Cl
recipes.description: Traditional Catalan bread rubbed with ripe tomato and drizzled with olive oil

steps.instruction: Toast bread slices until golden and warm
Rub the cut side of garlic over each slice
Rub the halved tomato firmly over the bread surface
Drizzle generously with olive oil
Sprinkle with flaky salt and serve immediately

recipes.name: Tumbet
recipes.description: Layered Mallorcan vegetables with tomato sauce, baked until golden

steps.instruction: Fry eggplant, zucchini, and potato slices in olive oil until golden, set aside
Sauté pepper strips until soft
Sauté garlic with paprika, add grated tomato and cook into a thick sauce
Layer potato, eggplant, zucchini, and pepper in a baking dish
Pour tomato sauce over the top
Drizzle with olive oil and bake at 180C for 25 minutes

recipes.name: Tarta de Santiago
recipes.description: Moist almond cake from Galicia dusted with powdered sugar in the shape of a cross

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 180C and grease a 23cm round pan
Beat eggs and sugar until thick and pale
Fold in almond flour, lemon zest, and cinnamon
Pour batter into prepared pan
Bake for 35-40 minutes until golden and set
Cool completely, dust with powdered sugar through a cross stencil

recipes.name: Polvorones
recipes.description: Crumbly almond shortbread cookies from Andalusia, a Christmas tradition

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 160C and line a baking sheet
Mix almond flour, powdered sugar, cinnamon, and lemon zest
Stir in melted butter until a dough forms
Roll into walnut-sized balls and place on the sheet
Flatten slightly with a fork
Bake for 15-18 minutes until just set but not browned
Cool and dust generously with powdered sugar

recipes.name: Pestiños
recipes.description: Honey-glazed fried pastry twists from Andalusia, crispy and fragrant

steps.instruction: Combine flour, wine, and olive oil into a smooth dough
Rest dough for 30 minutes covered
Roll out thin and cut into rectangles
Fold and twist each piece into a bow shape
Deep fry at 180C until golden, about 2 minutes per side
Drain and immediately dip in warm honey
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and cinnamon, let set

recipes.name: Leche Frita
recipes.description: Custard rounds that are chilled, coated in cinnamon sugar, and fried until crisp

steps.instruction: Heat milk with lemon zest until just simmering
Whisk cornstarch with sugar and egg yolks
Slowly pour hot milk into the egg mixture, then return to heat
Stir constantly until very thick, about 5 minutes
Pour into a lined dish and chill for 3 hours until firm
Cut into rounds, coat in flour then beaten egg
Fry in hot oil until golden on both sides
Dust with cinnamon sugar and serve warm

recipes.name: Torrijas
recipes.description: Spanish-style French toast soaked in milk and honey, traditionally for Semana Santa

steps.instruction: Heat milk with cinnamon stick and lemon zest until simmering
Remove from heat and let steep for 10 minutes
Soak bread slices in the warm milk for 30 seconds per side
Dip soaked bread in beaten egg
Fry in oil over medium heat until golden on both sides
Heat honey and drizzle over torrijas
Dust with cinnamon and serve warm

recipes.name: Natillas
recipes.description: Silky Spanish custard flavored with lemon and cinnamon, served with cookies

steps.instruction: Heat milk with lemon zest and cinnamon stick until simmering
Whisk egg yolks, sugar, and cornstarch until pale
Slowly pour warm milk into the egg mixture
Return to low heat and stir constantly until thickened
Remove cinnamon stick and lemon zest, add vanilla
Pour into serving dishes and chill for 2 hours
Dust with cinnamon and serve with cookies

recipes.name: Arroz con Leche
recipes.description: Creamy Spanish rice pudding slow-cooked with lemon, cinnamon, and condensed milk

steps.instruction: Rinse rice and place in a heavy pot with milk, lemon zest, and cinnamon stick
Bring to a gentle simmer over low heat
Stir frequently to prevent sticking for 40-50 minutes
When rice is very soft and mixture is creamy, add sugar and vanilla
Stir for 5 more minutes until sugar dissolves
Remove lemon zest and cinnamon stick
Serve warm or chilled, dusted with cinnamon

recipes.name: Pollo al Ajillo Clasico
recipes.description: Garlic chicken from Andalusia

steps.instruction: Brown chicken pieces in olive oil.
Add garlic cloves and thyme.
Pour in white wine.
Simmer until chicken is tender and sauce reduced.

recipes.name: Tarta de Santiago Gallega
recipes.description: Almond cake from Galicia

steps.instruction: Beat eggs with sugar until fluffy.
Fold in ground almonds, lemon zest, and cinnamon.
Pour into greased cake pan.
Bake at 180C for 30 minutes, dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.name: Pollo con Cerezas
recipes.description: Chicken with cherries and balsamic

steps.instruction: Season and brown chicken.
Add garlic and thyme.
Add cherries and balsamic.
Simmer until chicken is cooked.
